verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs list milestones and due dates as issue features. The API's Milestone model carries a due_on date-time with open/closed issue counts, and the create and edit endpoints accept it, so issues can be grouped into milestones that have due dates. missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of milestone use, in-depth first-party docs on the milestone UI workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can group issues into milestones with due dates

citations.quote: Issues support features like branches, tags, milestones, assignments, time tracking, due dates, dependencies, and more.
the spec's Milestone definition includes a due_on date-time property alongside title, description, state, and open/closed issue counts
